annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 of 26 July 2023 on harmonised standards for machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 of 26 July 2023 on harmonised standards for machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 194/45
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision publishing consolidated references of harmonised machinery standards under Directive 2006/42/EC, conferring presumption of conformity. It repeals Communication 2018/C 092/01 and Decision 2019/436, lists A-, B- and C-type standards (including ISO 10218 industrial robots and ISO 13482 personal care robots), restrictions and withdrawal dates.
key_provisions_or_claims: Publishes references of harmonised machinery standards in the OJEU, giving presumption of conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC
Repeals Communication 2018/C 092/01 and Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 with transitional application
Annexes list A-, B-, C-type standards including EN ISO 10218-1/-2 and EN ISO 13482
Sets withdrawal dates for superseded standards
